task_description: Convert CivicConnect from in-memory storage to MongoDB using Mongoose. Update the database URI, create proper Mongoose models for User/Issue/Comment, and rewrite all three services to use Mongoose queries instead of in-memory arrays while maintaining the same API response shapes for frontend compatibility.

verification.summary: Server starts successfully and connects to MongoDB Atlas. All models, services, and controllers are properly migrated from in-memory arrays to Mongoose. No test framework exists in the project so test_quality is skipped.
